u2-clt-panels.alt: Three panels. Top: the population of wait times, a strongly right-skewed curve with mean 5 minutes and standard deviation 5 minutes. Middle: histogram of 2000 simulated sample means for samples of 2, still skewed right. Bottom: histogram of 2000 sample means for samples of 30, close to a symmetric bell shape centered at 5 with a much smaller spread, about 0.91 minutes.
